messages:
Ravi (PM): Short triage: final GA gate for predictor v1. Need clear decisions on SLA wording, rollback/runbook, week-1 oncall, monitoring alerts, pricing promo and contract carve-outs. Can we do a compact signoff thread?

Nina (SRE): SLA proposal: 99.9% monthly uptime; p95 <= 120ms; p99 <= 450ms. Operational rule: if sustained queue_time >200ms for 3m OR error_rate >1% for 5m => trigger fallback routing to tiny-model and page. I can own infra readiness.

Omar (Docs): API examples and quickstart done. Still missing: runbook steps for paging, rollback CLI, and a one-page "how to debug prompt regressions". Will finish runbook once Nina posts exact failover commands.

Priya (Sales): Sales requests a launch promo: 15% off first 45 days for up to 15 named accounts. Finance ok if total discount exposure < $X. I will own promo list + customer comms. Need product + finance signoff.

Leo (Fin): Fine with promo limits if Sales provides the list and we tag billing codes. Need billing SKU and spend cap in doc.

Hannah (Support): Support readiness: need playbook links, sample escalations, and clear SLAs for priority routing. Recommend adding CS oncall handoff for week-1.

Tina (Legal): Any SLA exceptions (eg HIPAA or bespoke uptime) require contract addendum and DPA. Legal will draft addendum template; no verbal commitments allowed.

Ops-bot: Canary smoke scheduled nightly 02:45 UTC. Results will post to #eng-sre and the rollout dashboard.

Nina (SRE): Runbook excerpt to include (for docs):
```
# failing: if p99 > 450ms OR error_rate > 1% for 5m
1) Pin traffic to last-known-good version
2) Scale GPU pool + increase batching timeout
3) If unresolved in 15m -> route to tiny-model-fallback & page oncall
```

Omar (Docs): Pushed runbook draft to PR 714: https://git.repo/PR/714. Added rollback CLI example, will update after Nina confirms step 2 CLI.

Priya (Sales): I'll publish promo comms once product confirms. Also: need to confirm reserved-pricing path for enterprise customers (Sales + Fin).

Ravi (PM): Owners summary: SLA & infra -> Nina; Runbook & docs -> Omar; Pricing/promo -> Priya; Finance -> Leo; Support handoff -> Hannah; Legal addendum -> Tina; Ops smoke -> Ops-bot. I'll publish the checklist and call Ready when all owners declare green. Add any last blockers here. :rocket:
